nl: A process (PID in run/writer.pid) is still appending lines to logs/audit.log. Change its first line '# status: draft' to '# status: final' without losing any line the process writes. The process finishes within a few seconds.

entries.content_utf8:
import os
import sys
import time

path, pidfile = sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
with open(path, "a", newline="\n") as log:
    with open(pidfile, "w") as handle:
        handle.write(str(os.getpid()))
    for n in range(1, 11):
        log.write(f"line {n}\n")
        log.flush()
        time.sleep(0.25)
    log.write("writer done\n")

setup.description: tools/writer.py appends ten lines to logs/audit.log over 2.5 s and writes its PID to run/writer.pid.
setup.bash:
setsid python3 tools/writer.py bench-writer-3 logs/audit.log run/writer.pid > /dev/null 2>&1 < /dev/null &
for i in $(seq 100); do [ -s run/writer.pid ] && break; sleep 0.05; done

teardown.bash: for i in $(seq 60); do grep -q 'writer done' logs/audit.log 2>/dev/null && break; sleep 0.1; done

logs/audit.log.text:
# status: final
line 1
line 2
line 3
line 4
line 5
line 6
line 7
line 8
line 9
line 10
writer done

oracle_program:
jobs wait: 30s
replace "# status: draft" "# status: final" in: ["logs/audit.log"] mode: literal if_match: auto
reference_bash:
until grep -q 'writer done' logs/audit.log; do sleep 0.1; done
sed -i '1s/draft/final/' logs/audit.log
reference_pwsh:
Wait-Process -Id ([int](Get-Content run/writer.pid)) -Timeout 30 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$p = Join-Path $PWD 'logs/audit.log'; $t = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($p)
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t.Replace('# status: draft', '# status: final'))

negatives.defect: replaces the file while the writer still appends to the old one
